author: Ari Koslow
title: Braydon Fisher placed on bereavement list
desc: The Blue Jays placed RHP Braydon Fisher on the bereavement list.
impact: Fisher will be away for a few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Springer activated from family medical emergency list
desc: The Blue Jays activated OF/DH George Springer from the family medical emergency list.
impact: Springer should be back in the lineup on Tuesday. He is slashing .221/.308/.373 with eight home runs through 279 plate appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer (back) to make rehab start Wednesday
desc: Max Scherzer is scheduled to make his next rehab start on Wednesday for Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Scherzer threw 49 pitches during a rehab outing for High-A Vancouver last Friday. He should be activated after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cameron Weston optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles optioned RHP Cameron Weston to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Weston did not make an appearance since being called up.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Laweryson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Twins optioned RHP Cody Laweryson to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Lawyerson will continue to move up and down throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kade Morris optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned RHP Kade Morris to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Morris should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Kelly released by Athletics
desc: The Athletics released RHP Michael Kelly.
impact: Kelly passed through waivers unclaimed. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) to throw live BP Saturday
desc: Blake Snell will face hitters on Saturday in a live batting practice session.
impact: Snell is continuing to work his way back from an innovative NanoScope procedure to remove loose bodies from his elbow back in late May. If all goes well on Saturday, he should be nearing a rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Hamilton suffers hamstring injury Monday
desc: David Hamilton was removed from Monday's game against the Cardinals with left hamstring tightness.
impact: Hamilton will head to be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Bruihl suffers ankle injury Monday
desc: Justin Bruihl was removed from Monday's game against the Brewers with a left ankle sprain.
impact: Bruihl will head to be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status on Tuesday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax fans 10 hitters in loss Monday
desc: Griffin Jax allowed three runs on one hit and two walks while striking out 10 across five innings in Monday's 5-1 loss to the New York Yankees.
impact: Jax turned in a stellar outing on Monday, allowing just one hit while striking out a season-high 10 batters. The only blemish came in the fifth inning, when he issued back-to-back walks before surrendering a three-run homer to Jose Caballero. He responded by striking out the next two hitters to end the frame and did not return for the sixth. Through 13 starts this season, Jax owns a 2.89 ERA and 1.11 WHIP with 58 strikeouts across 56 innings. He is scheduled to make his next start on Saturday against the Mariners.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Angel Chivilli recalled by Yankees
desc: Angel Chivilli was recalled to the big-league club by the New York Yankees.
impact: Chivilli has spent the majority of the season at the Triple-A level, pitching to a 1.08 ERA and a 0.72 WHIP in 16 2/3 innings. Meanwhile, he has allowed one run while striking out four in 3 2/3 innings with the Yankees.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Sam Aldegheri optioned to Triple-A Salt Lake
desc: Sam Aldegheri has been optioned to the Triple-A Salt Lake Bees.
impact: Aldegheri has struggled a bit throughout the 2026 season, as has the majority of the Angels' pitching staff. Through 33 2/3 innings this year, the left-hander has a 5.08 ERA and a WHIP of 1.43.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Tayler Saucedo recalled by Angels
desc: Tayler Saucedo has been recalled to the big-league club by the Angels.
impact: Saucedo has spent the majority of the 2026 season with the Triple-A Salt Lake Bees, pitching just 2 1/3 innings in five appearances with the Angels. At the Triple-A level, the left-hander has a 6.75 ERA and 32 strikeouts in 30 2/3 innings pitched.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Carlos Duran added to Dodgers' 40-man roster
desc: Carlos Duran was added to the Los Angeles Dodgers' 40-man roster on Monday.
impact: Duran has been an impactful reliever for Triple-A Oklahoma City this season, boasting a 3.86 ERA and striking out 50 batters in 35 innings of work. The 6-foot-7 right-hander has made just one appearance at the MLB level in his career, a one-out outing for the Athletics in 2025.
